nodes.label: TeamPanel Masterplan (Spezifikation, Source of Truth)
nodes.rationale: Central source of truth; deviations and contradictions are documented in entscheidungen-und-risiken.md, not here.

nodes.label: TeamPanel
nodes.rationale: Universal, modular, industry-neutral team operating system for SMEs (AT/EU); SaaS with Free/Pro/Business; V1 without AI.

nodes.label: Grundprinzipien: Einfachheit, Modularitaet, Konfigurierbarkeit
nodes.rationale: User should feel 'I build my own team system' instead of adapting to complicated HR software.

nodes.label: Produktstruktur (Ebene A Plattform / B Kernmodule / C Erweiterungen)
nodes.rationale: Architecture must enable future extensions (level C) without making V1 unnecessarily complicated.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant-Architektur
nodes.rationale: Tenant separation must be enforced at database level (RLS + organization_id on every tenant table), not only in the frontend.

nodes.label: Account-/Mitgliedschaftsmodell (users, organizations, memberships)
nodes.rationale: One account may later be member of several organizations, so no users.organization_id.

nodes.label: Owner-Rolle
nodes.rationale: Owner must never be accidentally locked out of the organization.

nodes.label: Permission System (Permission Keys)
nodes.rationale: Permissions never hardcoded to role names; frontend permissions are UX only, real security server/database side.

nodes.label: Onboarding Setup-Assistent (7 Schritte)
nodes.rationale: User must not land in an empty dashboard after registration.

nodes.label: Dashboard Builder (vorbereitete Widgets)
nodes.rationale: V1 has no free-form page builder; prepared modular widgets that can be enabled/disabled/reordered.

nodes.label: Modulsystem (module_key, required_plan)
nodes.rationale: Navigation built dynamically from enabled modules; disabling a module must not delete data.

nodes.label: Module Registry
nodes.rationale: Central registry (requiredPermission, requiredEntitlement, navigation, routes) so new modules can be added later.

nodes.label: Mitarbeitermodul (Status invited/active/inactive/archived)
nodes.rationale: Employees with historical data are archived rather than deleted.

nodes.label: Standorte (Locations)
nodes.rationale: Location access can be role dependent; manager Vienna must not automatically see Graz data.

nodes.label: Zeiterfassungs-Events (CLOCK_IN, BREAK_START, BREAK_END, CLOCK_OUT)
nodes.rationale: Event model instead of start/end gives a traceable history from which working time is computed.

nodes.label: Korrekturanfrage (manuelle Zeitkorrektur)
nodes.rationale: Employees must not invisibly alter past time; corrections go through manager approval and create audit entries.

nodes.label: Dienstplan Publishing (Entwurf/Veroeffentlichen)
nodes.rationale: Prevents unfinished plans from becoming visible to employees.

nodes.label: Urlaub und Abwesenheit
nodes.rationale: Sickness data handled carefully; no unnecessary medical information requested.

nodes.label: Wiederkehrende Aufgaben (Recurrence Rule)
nodes.rationale: Store a recurrence rule and generate tasks on demand instead of pre-creating thousands of future tasks.

nodes.label: Dokumente
nodes.rationale: Files served via private storage buckets and signed URLs; private employee documents must not be visible to others.

nodes.label: Entitlement-System
nodes.rationale: Plans controlled via entitlements instead of 'if plan == pro'; limits changeable without code changes.

nodes.label: Free / Pro / Business Tarife
nodes.rationale: Prices are product decisions and must not be anchored deep in code.

nodes.label: Stripe Billing
nodes.rationale: Stripe is the sole source of payment status; DB only mirrors it; frontend never claims a customer paid.

nodes.label: Grace Period (active/past_due/grace_period/restricted/cancelled)
nodes.rationale: Do not delete customer data because of one failed payment; restricted mode keeps data readable.

nodes.label: Empfohlener Tech-Stack
nodes.rationale: Cheap, maintainable, modern, scalable, well suited for development with Claude.

nodes.label: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, RLS, Edge Functions)
PWA (Responsive Web-App)
nodes.rationale: No separate native Android/iOS app needed initially; one PWA works on desktop, mobile and tablet.

nodes.label: Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Colors must not be scattered through code.

nodes.label: Database Constraints
nodes.rationale: Database must enforce critical rules, not only frontend validation.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Users may only read rows whose organization_id matches an active membership, then additional permission rules.

nodes.label: Service Role Key (darf nie im Browser landen)
Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Normal employees must not be able to manipulate audit logs.

nodes.label: DSGVO / Privacy by Design
nodes.rationale: Data minimization from the start; store 'Abwesend' rather than diagnoses; no covert employee surveillance.

nodes.label: Backups mit getestetem Restore
nodes.rationale: A backup without a tested restore is not a complete backup strategy.

nodes.label: Feature Flags
nodes.rationale: Larger features are not released to everyone at once; pilot customers can test them.

nodes.label: Performance (Query Caching, Lazy Loading, Code Splitting)
ai_module (zukuenftige KI)
nodes.rationale: Future AI may only see data the user may see; it must never bypass RLS or the permission system.

nodes.label: Entwicklungsreihenfolge (Phase 0-16)
nodes.rationale: No further large feature before RBAC works; pilot without immediate broad release.

nodes.label: Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: A feature is not done just because the UI is visible.

nodes.label: Repository-Struktur
nodes.rationale: Domain logic must not be scattered across UI components.

nodes.label: Modul-interne Struktur
nodes.rationale: Each module should stay as isolated as possible.

nodes.label: Zukuenftiger Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Modules must not be coupled so tightly that a marketplace becomes impossible.

nodes.label: Secure by default
nodes.rationale: New features default to no access until explicitly allowed.
